flag.PF: Parity flag: even number of 1 bits in the low byte

device.trafficLights.info: Port 4 (word). Bits 0-2, 3-5, 6-8, 9-11: red, yellow, green of lights 1-4.  Example: mov ax, 0000001001001001b / out 4, ax
device.stepper.info: Port 7. Write the half-step sequence 001, 011, 010, 110, 100, 101 to turn clockwise (reverse it for counter-clockwise). Bit 7 of IN AL, 7 is 1 when ready.
device.led.info: Port 199 (word): shows the signed number written with OUT 199, AX.
device.thermometer.info: IN AL, 125 reads the temperature in °C. OUT 127, AL with 1 turns the heater on, 0 turns it off.
device.robot.info: Port 9 command: 1 forward, 2 turn left, 3 turn right, 4 examine, 5 lamp on, 6 lamp off. Port 10: examine result (0 empty, 255 wall, 7 lamp on, 8 lamp off). Port 11 status: bit 0 data ready, bit 2 error. Click cells to edit the map.
device.printer.info: Text printed with INT 21h/05h, INT 17h or by writing to handle 4.
device.ports.info: Every IN / OUT the program performs, newest first.

reference.title: Instruction reference
asm.UnterminatedString: The text is missing its closing quote.
asm.UndefinedSymbol: '{0}' is not defined (label or variable not found).
asm.ExpectedExpression: A value or expression is expected here.
asm.InvalidOperands: These operands cannot be used with this instruction.
asm.OperandCount: Wrong number of operands for this instruction.
asm.SizeMismatch: Operand sizes do not match (for example an 8-bit and a 16-bit register).
asm.SizeUnknown: Operand size is unknown. Use BYTE PTR or WORD PTR.
asm.ValueOutOfRange: Value {0} does not fit in the operand.
asm.JumpOutOfRange: Jump target is too far ({0} bytes). Short jumps reach -128..127 bytes.
asm.DivisionByZero: Division by zero in an expression.
asm.MacroRecursion: Macros or includes are nested too deeply.
asm.MissingEndm: MACRO or REPT block has no ENDM.
asm.NotConstant: A constant value is required here.
asm.ImmediateDestination: A constant cannot be the destination operand.
asm.MemoryToMemory: Both operands cannot be memory. Move through a register.
asm.SegmentImmediate: A segment register cannot be loaded with a constant or another segment register. Use a general register (e.g. MOV AX, value / MOV DS, AX).
asm.NoCode: The program does not contain any code.
asm.TooManyPasses: Label addresses did not settle; check jumps near their range limit.
asm.ConditionalMismatch: IF / ELSE / ENDIF do not match.
